g.text: Warm worker pool · median of 6 jobs after one first job · error bars show observed min/max
Core Ultra 9 185H · 8 workers · sampling, transforms and checksum included; file IO excluded.
Before/after outputs match frozen Dense SHA-256 in the file benchmark. Noise is stored; text uses Zstd.
Original numeric can be faster with larger output. RAR/7z process-time and ratio comparisons are in measurements.md.
